_comment: Emergency contacts. The most safety-critical data on this site — a wrong number here costs a dog. Nothing in this file may be inferred, rounded, or carried over from a listing site. Every number needs a first-party confirmation call before verifiedDate is set, and the hours need re-checking seasonally because urgent-care hours at coastal practices move with the season. THIS RULE IS NOW ENFORCED AT BUILD TIME: scripts/check-build.mjs fails the build if headline.fact reaches dist/ while headline.verifiedDate is null. It went unenforced for months and an unverified categorical claim shipped on six pages as the most important line on each of them.

headline.fact: There is no 24-hour emergency vet in Sussex County.
headline.detail: That is the single most important thing on this page. If your dog is in trouble at 11pm at Rehoboth, the nearest round-the-clock option is an hour or more away. Know which one you're driving to BEFORE you need it — pick one now and put it in your phone.

provisional.fact: Work out where you would drive, before you need to.
provisional.detail: Round-the-clock veterinary cover near the Delaware beaches is thin, and the hours below are the ones each practice publishes — I have not yet rung any of them to confirm. Pick one now, ring it to check it is open when you think it is, and put the number in your phone. Doing that on a Tuesday afternoon is free. Doing it at 11pm with a sick dog in the car is not.

vets.name: Delmarva Animal Emergency Center
vets.hoursNote: NOT 24/7 on weekdays — it opens at 6pm and closes at 8am. A Tuesday afternoon emergency is not covered here.

vets.name: Pet's ER
vets.hoursNote: Hours not published anywhere I can reach, and I have not rung them. It is the closest option to Fenwick and Bethany on the map, which is exactly why that blank matters — do not drive here on the strength of this listing without ringing first. Also unconfirmed: whether they take Delaware clients.

vets.name: BluePearl Pet Hospital, Christiana
vets.hoursNote: The only genuine round-the-clock option in Delaware, but it is at the top of the state — a long drive from the beaches.

vets.name: Rehoboth Beach Animal Hospital
vets.hoursNote: Publishes urgent care Monday to Friday, as a curbside service, inside those office hours. Not overnight and not on weekends — the two windows a beach trip is most likely to need. Its own site points you elsewhere for after-hours care. Nearest of anything on this list if the problem starts on a weekday afternoon.

source.label: Rehoboth Beach Animal Hospital — urgent care and location
source.note: Read 8 August 2026. States urgent care is offered "Monday - Friday as a curbside service" and publishes the office hours above. I had this wrong: an earlier version of this record said the practice describes no urgent care, because I read rehobothanimalhospital.com rather than rehobothbeachvet.com. Same practice, same phone number, different site.

statewide.label: Emergency: people
statewide.note: Always. Beach emergencies, injuries, anything time-critical.

statewide.label: Delaware SPCA
statewide.note: Stray and loose-dog intake. Number not yet confirmed.

statewide.label: Animal Poison Control (ASPCA)
statewide.note: 24 hours. A consultation fee usually applies. Useful for a swallowed bait, a bloom exposure, or anything eaten off the sand.
